content.comment_body: Is it possible with [product_name] to manually enter a value using a keyboard, then compare it with the counter value and adjust accordingly—if the manual value is higher, increase; if lower, decrease? In this setup, the manually entered value determines whether the arm moves forward (if greater), backward (if less), or remains stationary (if equal). Thanks for your help, and apologies for any language issues.
